source.author: verg
source.text: conveniunt, quibus aut odium crudele tyranni aut metus acer erat; navis, quae forte paratae, corripiunt, onerantque auro: portantur avari Pygmalionis opes pelago; dux femina facti.
source.text_original: conveniunt, quibus aut odium crudele tyranni / aut metus acer erat; navis, quae forte paratae, / corripiunt, onerantque auro: portantur avari / Pygmalionis opes pelago; dux femina facti.
source.text_english: Those assemble who either had savage hatred of the tyrant or sharp fear; they seize the ships, which happened to be ready, and load them with gold: the riches of avaricious Pygmalion are borne over the sea; a woman is leader of the deed.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: memento igitur nostri et cura, ut in Christo ualeas, atque, ut cetera taceam, domestica sanctae Uerae exempla sectare, quae uere secuta Christum peregrinationis molestiam sustinet, et sit tibi tanti dux femina facti.
reuse.text_original: memento igitur nostri et cura, ut in Christo ualeas, atque, ut cetera taceam, domestica sanctae Uerae exempla sectare, quae uere secuta Christum peregrinationis molestiam sustinet, et sit tibi tanti dux femina facti.
reuse.text_english: Therefore remember us, and take care to be well in Christ; and, to pass over the rest, follow the domestic example of the holy Vera, who, having truly followed Christ, endures the hardships of travel, and may a woman be for you the leader of so great a deed.
